name: later-guarding-stays-within-the-bound
description: V2 (U2, the reviewer's counterexample): the proposer and executor count toward the bound at the proposal whether guarded or not, so when both become guarded later a claim still needs at most 19 guards, and the effect stays within MAX_UNCONSUMED_APPROVALS (36) and MAX_APPROVALS (55)

steps.note: 18 carried, the unguarded proposer and executor make 20
both become guarded after the proposal
the executor's guard hasn't approved: 19 guards
19 guard approvals, the rule approval being the first guard's own; 16 open by members, at most 36 unconsumed
